read.en: ASML rose 0.7% on Oct 23 to $1,571.80, trading between $1,550.00 and $1,581.64 on light volume (0.66 times its 20-day average). It is below the falling 5-day ($1,617.4), 10-day ($1,650.4), 30-day ($1,713.2) and 100-day ($1,748.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,588.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,771.13), and RSI is 35.

The $1,550 low undercut Wednesday's $1,556 low but held above the $1,530.6 July low. Resistance is $1,582–1,594 (Oct 23 high, 200-day, Oct 15 low), then $1,614–1,617 (Oct 20 low, 5-day) and $1,650 (10-day). Support is $1,550 (Oct 23 low), then $1,530.6 and $1,441 (May 19 low). A close above $1,594 would target $1,617; a close below $1,530 would open $1,441.
